Fixture: cnbc.com-style OneTrust CCPA (reject-all reloads the page)

Mirrors the documented cnbc.com OneTrust deployment (docs/cmp-impact-map.md): a top-level shell whose "Continue" button only dismisses the shell (not an opt-out), a "Your Privacy Choices" opener into the real preference center, and a single CCPA "_BG"-suffixed opt-out group (OSSTA_BG) rather than full GDPR categories. cnbc.com is a known reload-on-save host (ONETRUST_RELOAD_ON_SAVE_HOSTS / REJECT_RELOAD_GUARD_HOSTS) — this fixture reproduces that reload so the reload-survival path can be exercised deterministically, without depending on the real (Akamai-protected) cnbc.com.
